## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Northern-Sòng *biéjí* 別集 (literary collection) of **Yuánzhào** ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7), 1048–1116, the *Língzhī Dàzhì lǜshī* of *Língzhīsì* 靈芝寺 in Hángzhōu). Where the companion *Zhīyuán yíbiān* 芝園遺編 ([KR6k0216](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0216)) gathers his Vinayatreatise fragments and lecture pieces, the *Zhīyuán jí* preserves his **biographical, epitaphic and occasional prose**: stupa-inscriptions and life-records of contemporary monks, lay-funerary writings, and short essays. The set is the principal source for late-Northern-Sòng Hángzhōu Buddhist prosopography.

**Abstract**

The *Zhīyuán jí* is **the principal collection of Yuánzhào's literary prose**, parallel to the *Zhīyuán yíbiān* but covering biography and epitaph rather than treatise. It is one of the most important sources for the social history of Northern-Sòng Hángzhōu Buddhism: through Yuánzhào's stupa-inscriptions and *xíngyè jì* one can reconstruct the network of Sòng *jiào* 教 (Tiāntái-Huáyán scholastic) abbots, their patrons, and their lineage relationships. The lower fascicle also preserves Yuánzhào's *Gāolì Lǐ xiānggōng Lèdàojí xù* — his preface for the *Lèdào jí* of a Goryeo Chancellor *Lǐ*, an important document of Sòng-Goryeo literary contact (paired with his *Wèi Gāolì sēngtǒng Yìtiān kāijiǎng yàoyì* preserved in [KR6k0216](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0216)). Composition is bracketed by Yuánzhào's mature career and his death; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are accordingly set 1080–1116.
